scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src tests oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.format: oxfmt src tests package.json tsconfig.json oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src tests package.json tsconfig.json oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.ultracite:check: ultracite check src tests package.json tsconfig.json oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm test
scripts.web:publish: cd web && bun run build && wzrrd publish --file build --slug aie-loopcraft-workshop-2026
